<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Visa application submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Visa decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AdditionalDocuments" name="Request for additional documents"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Austrian representation office (BMEIA)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitApplication" name="Submit application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ResubmitApplication" name="Resubmit application" sourceRef="Task_ResubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Visa decision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_VisaDecisionReceived" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalDocuments" name="Request for additional documents" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_AdditionalDocumentsRequested" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PlanWorkLive" name="Plan work and living in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start parallel activities"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" name="Organize accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LivingArranged" name="Accommodation and bank account arranged"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineCompetence" name="Determine competent representation office"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType" name="Visa type and competence basis"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepresentationByResidence" name="Apply at Austrian representation of place of residence (type D visa)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepresentationByMainDestination" name="Apply at representation of main travel destination (Schengen visa)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepresentationByFirstEntry" name="Apply at representation of first Schengen entry state (no main destination)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompetenceMerge" name="Competent representation determined"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteVisaForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainTravelDocument" name="Provide valid travel document"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainPassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo (35 x 45 mm)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainHealthInsurance" name="Provide travel health insurance (EUR 30,000, Schengen area)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideMeansOfSubsistence" name="Provide proof of means of subsistence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" name="Gather other requested evidence"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubmissionMerge" name="Application submitted"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitOutcome" name="Await representation response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_VisaDecisionReceived" name="Visa decision received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_AdditionalDocumentsRequested" name="Additional documents requested">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AdditionalDocuments" messageRef="Message_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" name="Provide additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ResubmitApplication" name="Resubmit application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaOutcome" name="Visa outcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RenewalDue" name="Visa renewal due (every x months)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Renewal interval x is not specified in the description.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Renewal"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_PlanWorkLive" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_OrganizeAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" targetRef="End_LivingArranged"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="End_LivingArranged"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_DetermineCompetence" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Type D visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_RepresentationByResidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Schengen visa" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_RepresentationByMainDestination"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No main destination determinable" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType" targetRef="Task_RepresentationByFirstEntry"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RepresentationByResidence" targetRef="Gateway_CompetenceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RepresentationByMainDestination" targetRef="Gateway_CompetenceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RepresentationByFirstEntry" targetRef="Gateway_CompetenceMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_CompetenceMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteVisaForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_CompleteVisaForm" targetRef="Task_ObtainTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ObtainTravelDocument" targetRef="Task_ObtainPassportPhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ObtainPassportPhoto" targetRef="Task_ObtainHealthInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ObtainHealthInsurance" targetRef="Task_ProvideMeansOfSubsistence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMeansOfSubsistence" targetRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_GatherOtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_SubmissionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_SubmissionMerge" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitOutcome" targetRef="Event_VisaDecisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitOutcome" targetRef="Event_AdditionalDocumentsRequested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Event_AdditionalDocumentsRequested" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ResubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_ResubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_SubmissionMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Event_VisaDecisionReceived" targetRef="Gateway_VisaOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" name="Visa granted" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaOutcome" targetRef="Event_RenewalDue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" name="Visa refused" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaOutcome" targetRef="End_VisaRefused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Event_RenewalDue" targetRef="Task_DetermineCompetence"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
